# Multi-element rendering

This document exercises the full Quarto custom-node taxonomy that
q2-preview's iframe must render with element-and-class parity to the
HTML pipeline.

::: {.callout-note}
Heads up — callouts use the three-deep Bootstrap nesting pattern.
:::

::: {#thm-pythagoras .theorem}
For a right triangle with legs of length $a$ and $b$ and hypotenuse $c$,
$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.
:::

The Pythagorean identity is stated in @thm-pythagoras.

$$e = mc^2$$ {#eq-einstein}
